gt_summary: Desktop clutter: CV, to-do list, donor's note to the Archives, screenshots.
Main documents tree: research (survey, manuscripts, grants, literature), talks, CV, teaching, service, admin and personal.
Administrative records: restricted personnel file and a reimbursement form containing an SSN.
Lab administration: safety SOP, roster with keys and phones, lab logo files.
Personal and household material: taxes, recipes, fantasy football, household budget.
All research material for the Prairie Bee Survey and its publications and funding.
NSF award DEB-1900417: proposal, budget, data-management plan and annual reports.
Downloaded reprints by other authors: two carry her annotations, one is off-topic, plus a citation export.
Manuscript drafts, reviews, LaTeX sources and published versions of Prairie Bee Survey papers.
Complete paper trail for the 2021 restoration-age article: four drafts, review response, LaTeX, published PDF.
Side projects outside the bee survey: mosquito collaboration data and 2014 monarch outreach notes.
The Prairie Bee Survey: data, analysis code, figures, GIS, field notebooks, photographs and lab drive copy.
GIS: exact and public site layers in GeoJSON, a shapefile set, KML and maps.
Copy of the lab external drive: dataloggers, model outputs, barcodes, GPS, panoramas, instrument files, student backups, nested junk folders.
Deeply nested 'New Folder' chain ending in a small but important coordinates file.
Analysis code: R, R Markdown, Python, SQL, Jupyter, config, logs, a credentials file and a bytecode cache.
Survey data: raw yearly specimen CSVs, quadrats, processed tables, site metadata and EML.
Scanned handwritten field notebooks (PDF and raw TIFF scanner output).
Field photographs by year and site with EXIF GPS, including a burst sequence of near-duplicates.
Publication figures generated by the analysis.
Landowner oral-history interview: WAV master and MP3 access copy.
Specimen image TIFF masters and JPEG/WebP web derivatives.
Field video: narrated pan-trap timelapse and aerial pan.
Service: prairie society statement, confidential promotion notes, a confidential peer review.
Slide decks: departmental seminar on the survey and a garden-club outreach talk.
Course materials: one syllabus worth keeping, an older duplicate syllabus, and a FERPA-protected gradebook.
Browser downloads: saved web pages, installers, archives and miscellany.
Exported email: saved .eml messages sorted by the donor into research, professional and miscellaneous folders, plus a Thunderbird mbox export.
Mixed miscellany: building/IT notices, vendor spam, phishing, newsletters, plus restricted personnel, family and student messages.
Research correspondence about the Prairie Bee Survey: methods, statistical results, peer review, DNR location policy, landowner history.
Career and outreach correspondence: media request, seminar logistics, dissertation advising, international visit.
Personal music library.
Backup of the 2004-2009 computer: legacy Word/Excel/PowerPoint files, encodings, early pilot data and notes.
Pictures folder: phone photos (whiteboard, garden bee) and family photographs.
Family snapshots unrelated to university work.
